response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), r AS (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_qty, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_qty IS NULL, avg_qty DESC) AS rnk FROM g) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_qty, avg_ratio, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3
